business_objective: Transfer workspace ownership to an eligible existing member while preserving confirmed membership and transfer-state rules.

stakeholder_statements.text: The current workspace owner selects an existing workspace member and submits an ownership transfer request.
The account steward checks that the selected member is active and that no other ownership transfer is pending.
The proposed owner may accept or decline the ownership transfer.
After acceptance, the account steward records the proposed owner as the new workspace owner and keeps the former owner as a workspace member.
The transfer is closed only after the new owner is recorded. Subscription-plan changes and billing-profile updates are outside this project.

business_objective: Coordinate the recollection and review of specimens rejected during laboratory intake.

stakeholder_statements.text: When a submitted specimen is rejected, the laboratory receptionist records the affected specimen and the rejection reason.
The clinical unit coordinator receives the recollection request, assigns it to a collector, and sets a priority. The priority choices are not agreed.
The collector records that the new specimen was collected and adds any collection note.
The laboratory reviewer records whether the recollected specimen is accepted or returned for another collection. The acceptance criteria have not been finalized.
The clinical unit coordinator sends the review outcome to the requesting clinical unit. The delivery channel is undecided, and clinical diagnosis is outside this project.

business_objective: Control the testing, design review, and release of construction material samples before installation.

stakeholder_statements.text: The site material coordinator submits a material sample and identifies its proposed use on the project.
The test technician records the tests performed and the results for the sample. The required test set has not been agreed.
The design representative records whether the sample is accepted or rejected and adds review comments. The acceptance criteria are not finalized.
The site storekeeper may release the related material for installation only after the sample is accepted.
A rejected sample record is returned to the site material coordinator for replacement. Supplier payment is outside this project.

business_objective: Review grant milestone evidence and determine whether the next funded activity becomes eligible to proceed.

stakeholder_statements.text: The grant recipient submits a milestone report with the completed activities and supporting evidence.
The program monitor checks whether the report is complete and returns it when required items are missing. The completeness checklist has not been agreed.
The technical reviewer records whether the milestone was achieved and adds review comments.
The finance checker records whether the spending evidence supports the reported milestone. The accepted spending-evidence categories are not finalized.

The portfolio lead may mark the next activity eligible only when the milestone is achieved and the spending evidence supports it. Releasing payments and amending grant agreements are outside this project.

business_objective: Create and administer legal preservation holds while retaining unresolved rules about hold-release authority.

stakeholder_statements.text: The matter lead requests a legal hold and identifies the matter, the people, and the records that must be preserved.
Legal counsel confirms the hold scope and records preservation instructions. The required retention period has not been agreed.
The records coordinator sends the hold notice to the identified data custodians and records their acknowledgements.
The data custodian confirms that preservation has started and reports any identified records that are unavailable. Custodians should receive the release instruction only from the records coordinator.

Legal counsel records when the matter has ended and says counsel may release the hold directly without waiting for the records coordinator. Nobody has decided who handles reports of unavailable records. The team also joked that the archive boxes have been around longer than some employees.
